definitions.explanation: The set of documents required when applying for a job, contest, grant, or program. Typically includes a resume, cover letter, and any additional required materials.

examples.japanese: {応募書類|おうぼしょるい}を{準備|じゅんび}する。
{応募書類|おうぼしょるい}の{締|し}め{切|き}りは{来週|らいしゅう}の{金曜日|きんようび}です。
examples.english: The deadline for application documents is next Friday.

examples.japanese: {応募書類|おうぼしょるい}に{不備|ふび}があった{場合|ばあい}、{選考|せんこう}の{対象外|たいしょうがい}となります。
examples.english: If there are deficiencies in the application documents, you will be excluded from the selection process.

notes:
Composed of {応募|おうぼ} (application, entry) and {書類|しょるい} (documents, papers). A common compound in job hunting ({就活|しゅうかつ}), scholarship applications, and contest entries.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {応募書類|おうぼしょるい}を{提出|ていしゅつ}する: to submit application documents
- {応募書類|おうぼしょるい}の{締|し}め{切|き}り: application document deadline
- {応募書類|おうぼしょるい}{選考|せんこう}: document screening (first stage of hiring)
- {応募書類|おうぼしょるい}に{不備|ふび}がある: deficiencies in application documents

RELATED TERMS:
- {履歴書|りれきしょ}: resume, CV — the standard Japanese-format resume
- {職務経歴書|しょくむけいれきしょ}: work history document — detailed career history, used alongside the resume
- エントリーシート: entry sheet — a company-specific application form, common in Japanese new-graduate hiring
